1 18.12.2023 Heard the learned counsel Mr. F. Haque appearing for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr.
R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor representing the State of Assam.

This is an application under Section 439 of the CrPC filed by the petitioners- namely, (1) Sri Ajoy Biswakarma and (2) Mrs. Minara Begum praying for releasing them on bail after they were arrested in connection with Biswanath Chariali P.S. Case No.167/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471 of the IPC.
On 09.11.2023, a person called Babul Hussain was apprehended by police while he was carrying a machine for making fake currency notes.
During the interrogation, he confessed before police that the present petitioners helped him in carrying the aforesaid machine to Guwahati.
I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsels of both sides.
Only on the basis of the statement of Babul Hussain, the present petitioners were arrest by police.
They have already spent 38 days in custody.
Considering the aforesaid fact, this Court is of the opinion that the Page No.# 3/3 abovementioned petitioners do not deserve to be detained in custody any further period of time.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

The petitioners- namely, (1) Sri Ajoy Biswakarma and (2) Mrs. Minara Begum is allowed to go on bail in connection with Biswanath Chariali P.S. Case No.167/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471 of the IPC on furnishing bail bond of 25,000/- each with one surety each of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Biswanath Chariali.
The bail application is disposed of.
